summary.text: Lana Greenfield is a Republican state representative from District 22 who returned to the House in January 2025 after earlier service from 2015 to 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a self-employed business owner and chairs the House Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Lana Greenfield's career experience includes working as a self-employed business owner, according to Ballotpedia.
She represented South Dakota House District 2 from 2015 to 2023 and assumed office in District 22 on January 14, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session, Greenfield chairs the House Education Committee and serves on the House Commerce and Energy Committee.
